notes: DiscoFlate v3.82.0 — 🪞 Mirror now flips the CAMERA only, not your overlays. It used to flip the finished frame, so switching it on to fix your own Discord tile made every viewer read your text backwards. Your text now reads correctly to viewers whichever way it is set. Also fixes /api/state reporting the mirror default as True while every other reader said False, which switched mirroring on without anyone asking.
